_comment: Seed papers for forward-citation snowballing. tier=core: LLM/VLM-agent-for-robotics lineage (every runtime agent paper is expected to cite at least one). tier=extend: seeds that cover lines the core lineage misses (reasoning VLAs, agents that design rewards/policies, multi-agent, lifelong). tier=broad: very widely cited general seeds; their citers are only kept if they pass the embodiment keyword filter.
